# Domain events

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/eventcatalog` (backend/) from domain/events. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every state-changing action raises a domain event: written to the outbox in
the same transaction as the change, published to NATS JetStream by the relay
(stream subjects `{domain}.>`). Consumers decide what an event means to them.

## Naming standard

`{domain}.{entity}.{verb}` -- e.g. `procurement.purchase_order.created`

- **domain** -- the bounded context, as in `backend/domain/<domain>` (one of the domains below).
- **entity** -- the aggregate or record acted on, singular snake_case: `purchase_order`, `purchase_order_line_item`.
- **verb** -- what happened, past tense snake_case. An event is a fact, never a command:
  `created`, `updated`, `deleted`, `status_changed`, `item_scanned` -- not `create`, `update_status`.
- All lowercase, exactly three dot-separated parts. Enforced by `domain/events/naming_test.go`.

Domains: `apikeys`, `channels`, `collections`, `coupons`, `customers`, `fx`, `iam`, `integrations`, `inventory`, `messagecenter`, `newsletter`, `notifications`, `oms`, `payments`, `pms`, `procurement`, `promotions`, `reviews`, `scheduler`, `settings`, `shipping`, `storefront`, `suppliers`, `tax`, `theme`, `webhook_forwarding`, `whatsapp`.

## Standard action event

Raised with one call inside the use case's `tenant.WithTenant` transaction:

```go
// 1. register the action once, in domain/events/actions_<domain>.go
SupplierUpdated = defineAction("suppliers.supplier.updated", "A supplier's details were changed.")

// 2. record it in the use case, atomic with the write
return eventrecord.Record(ctx, uc.outbox, events.SupplierUpdated, s.ID,
	eventrecord.NewChanges().Set("name", old.Name, s.Name).Set("lead_time_days", old.LeadTimeDays, s.LeadTimeDays))
```

Payload (`events.EntityAction`):

```json
{
  "event": "suppliers.supplier.updated",
  "event_id": "0b8a…",                       // dedupe key for consumers
  "occurred_at": "2026-10-06T12:00:00Z",
  "tenant_id": "…",
  "actor": { "type": "user", "user_id": "…", "role": "customer_admin" },  // or { "type": "system" }
  "entity_id": "…",
  "changes": { "lead_time_days": { "before": 14, "after": 21 } },          // updates: changed fields only
  "data": { … }                              // action-specific facts, see each event's description
}
```

`changes` and `data` are omitted when empty. Consumers needing the full record read it by `entity_id`.

## Catalog

65 events. **action** = standard `EntityAction` envelope above; **typed** = its own payload (fields listed).

### channels

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `channels.external_category_link.deleted` | action | A category mapping to an external shop was removed. | envelope |
| `channels.external_category_link.saved` | action | A CommerceOS category was linked to a category in an external shop (a person mapped it, or it was matched by slug on push). data: connection_id, provider, external_id, category_id, source (manual, slug_match). | envelope |
| `channels.import_job.created` | action | A product import from an external shop was queued. data: connection_id, default_warehouse_id, default_currency, is_first_import. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.created` | action | A product or variant was linked to a listing on an external channel. data: product_id, variant_id, connection_id, provider, external_id, is_variation, source (push, variant_added, link_existing, import). | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.deleted` | action | A listing was removed. data: product_id, variant_id, connection_id, provider, external_id, reason (shape_migration, variant_removed). | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.gated` | action | A listing was taken off sale on its channel because the product is no longer active (Woo status pushed, Bol offer put on hold). data: product_id, connection_id, provider, external_id. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.synced` | action | A listing was synced with its channel (a sync log entry was written; an unchanged successful re-sync records nothing). changes: the synced fields that changed since the previous sync, before/after as strings. data: product_id, connection_id, provider, external_id, direction (push, import), status (success, error), error_message. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.ungated` | action | A gated listing went back on sale after the product became active again. data: product_id, connection_id, provider, external_id. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.updated` | action | A listing's link changed (changes: variant_id, external_id, not_for_sale_note). data: product_id, connection_id, provider. | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel.created` | action | A sales channel (web shop, Bol, POS...) was set up. data: name, type, connection_id, enrollment_mode, currency_code. | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel.deleted` | action | A sales channel was deleted. data: name, type. | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel.updated` | action | A sales channel's settings changed (changes: name, connection_id, enrollment_mode, enrollment_category_id, enrollment_tag, price_adjustment_basis_points, quantity_breaks, default_warehouse_id, storefront_mode, sign_in_url, storefront_locale, storefront_locales, active, payment_connection_id). | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel_product_override.set` | action | A product was explicitly included in or excluded from a sales channel, overriding its enrollment rule. data: channel_id, product_id, included. | envelope |
| `channels.sync_schedule.saved` | action | An automatic sync schedule for a connection was created or changed. data: connection_id, entity_type, direction, enabled, interval_minutes, default_warehouse_id, default_currency. | envelope |

### oms

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oms.sales_order.status_changed` | typed | SalesOrderStatusChanged is raised whenever a SalesOrder's Status field actually transitions (never on creation, never a no-op write of the same value already there) -- see application/oms.UpdateSalesOrderUseCase, which is the one place Status ever changes, whatever the caller (a manual edit, a bulk update, or ImportWooOrdersUseCase routing a Woo order's own status change back through here). | `SalesOrderStatusChanged`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sales_order_id |

### payments

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payments.refund.issued` | typed | PaymentRefundIssued is raised whenever CompletePickingUseCase's replay successfully refunds a PickScanActionRefund row through the order's payment provider (Stripe/Revolut) -- see application/oms. | `PaymentRefundIssued`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sales_order_id, line_item_id, sku_id, quantity, amount_minor_units |
| `payments.refund.manual_review_required` | typed | PaymentRefundManualReviewRequired is raised whenever CompletePickingUseCase's replay stages a PickScanActionRefund row's line-item bookkeeping (see application/oms.CompletePickingUseCase's doc) but can't call the payment provider's refund API for real -- either the order has no known PaymentProvider/PaymentExternalID (e.g. an imported order), or the API call itself failed. | `PaymentRefundManualReviewRequired`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sales_order_id, line_item_id, sku_id, quantity, amount_minor_units |

### pms

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pms.category.changed` | typed | CategoryChanged is raised whenever a category's fields (name, parent, markup) change. | `CategoryChanged`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, category_id |

| `pms.product.translated` | typed | ProductTranslated is raised when a product's translated name/description change. | `ProductTranslated`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, product_id |
| `pms.sku.price_per_kilo_changed` | typed | SKUPricePerKiloChanged is raised when a scale-sold weight pool's price per kilo changes. | `SKUPricePerKiloChanged`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sku_id, old_price_per_kilo_minor_units, new_price_per_kilo_minor_units |
| `pms.variant.unlisted` | typed | VariantUnlisted is raised when a variant can no longer be sold on the channels it was listed on -- the variant was deleted, or its last SKU was. | `VariantUnlisted`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, product_id, variant_id, listings |

### procurement

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `procurement.booking.completed` | action | A stock booking was finished: scans became stock (inventory raises its own events) and the PO became received or partially_received. data: purchase_order_id, completed_by, missing_item_count. | envelope |
| `procurement.booking.paused` | action | A stock booking was paused. data: purchase_order_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.booking.resumed` | action | A paused stock booking was picked up again. data: purchase_order_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.booking.started` | action | Stock booking (scanning a delivery in) started for a purchase order. data: purchase_order_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.booking_scan.created` | action | An item was scanned during stock booking. data: booking_id, sku_id, action_type (receive, correction, damaged, lost), quantity, write_off_quantity, lot_number, expiry_date. | envelope |
| `procurement.booking_scan.deleted` | action | A booking scan was undone. data: booking_id, sku_id, action_type. | envelope |
| `procurement.goods.received` | typed | GoodsReceived is raised when a purchase-order line item's stock is actually received into inventory -- a real inventory.Batch created with a landed cost basis (application/inventory.ReceiveStockUseCase), not merely a PO being created or edited (see procurement.PurchaseOrder's own design: "don't change inventory cost merely because a PO was created"). | `GoodsReceived`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sku_id, warehouse_id, batch_id, purchase_order_line_item_id, quantity, landed_unit_cost_minor_units |
| `procurement.purchase_order.created` | action | A purchase order was created. data.source: manual, document or purchase_planner. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order.deleted` | action | A purchase order was deleted with its line items. data: supplier_id, status. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order.updated` | action | A purchase order changed (changes: supplier_id, warehouse_id, status, currency_code, expected_date, notes). data.reason is set when the system changed it: line_items_resolved (needs_review -> draft once every product line is linked). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.attached` | action | A supplier document (invoice / order confirmation file) was attached to a purchase order. data: purchase_order_id, file_name, content_type, parsing_job_id, duplicate_of_purchase_order_id (set when the same file is already on another PO; its lines are then copied instead of parsed). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.deleted` | action | A supplier document was removed from a purchase order (its file deleted from storage). data: purchase_order_id, file_name. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.parsed` | action | A supplier document was read into purchase order lines (each line also raises purchase_order_line_item.added, source document). data: purchase_order_id, parsing_job_id, line_count, unmatched_count, suggested_supplier_name, suggested_currency_code. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.parsing_retried` | action | Parsing of a supplier document was requested again. data: purchase_order_id, parsing_job_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.added` | action | A line was added to a purchase order. data: purchase_order_id, sku_id, quantity, units_per_purchased_item, unit_cost_minor_units, line_type, source -- manual, or duplicate_document (copied from the PO an identical document was already attached to). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.linked` | action | A purchase order line was linked to a catalog SKU (changes: sku_id, units_per_purchased_item). data: purchase_order_id, source -- manual (a person picked the SKU) or supplier_alias (matched from the supplier's learned aliases). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.removed` | action | A line was removed from a purchase order. data: purchase_order_id, sku_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.updated` | action | A purchase order line changed (changes: sku_id, raw_sku, raw_description, quantity, units_per_purchased_item, unit_cost_minor_units, line_type). data: purchase_order_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_discrepancy.acknowledged` | action | Someone reviewed an invoice discrepancy and accepted it. data: receiving_record_id, type. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_discrepancy.detected` | action | An invoice or delivery differs from its purchase order. data: receiving_record_id, type (missing_item, quantity_mismatch, unexpected_item, expiry_mismatch, damaged_item), line_item_id, expected_qty, received_qty, source -- invoice (found by comparing the invoice) or manual (flagged by a person, e.g. damaged). | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_discrepancy.linked` | action | An unexpected invoice line and a missing purchase order line were matched as the same item (both become acknowledged; one event each). data: receiving_record_id, type, linked_discrepancy_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_record.completed` | action | Review of an uploaded invoice was finished. data: purchase_order_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_record.created` | action | A supplier invoice was uploaded against a purchase order to check what was delivered. data: purchase_order_id, file_name, content_type, parsing_job_id, potential_duplicate. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_record.parsed` | action | An uploaded invoice was compared with its purchase order (each difference also raises receiving_discrepancy.detected). data: purchase_order_id, parsing_job_id, discrepancy_count. | envelope |
